luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description:
A parent selector that can be used to distinguish between multiple instances of a component within a page.
This can be leveraged to create 1-to-1 mappings between {@link UITestComponent}s so that functions
called on a component are limited only to the scope of that component in the UI.

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

confirmableInputActivationSelector.description: The selector to click to enable the confirmable input

confirmableButtonContainerSelector.description: Selector for the confirmable input button containers

confirmableCheckButtonSelector.description: Selector for check button on a confirmable text input

confirmableCancelButtonSelector.description: Selector for cancel button on a confirmable text input

timePickerSelector.description: Selector for the time picker dropdown

monthSelector.description: Selector for the month picker dropdown

yearSelector.description: Selector for the year picker dropdown

monthOptionSelector.description: Selector an option item in the {@link monthSelector}

yearOptionSelector.description: Selector an option item in the {@link yearSelector}

timeOptionSelector.description: Selector for the time items in the date time picker that correspond to the current time.

dateOptionSelector.description:
Selector for the date items in the calendar that correspond to the current month (not the filler
cells for the previous or next month).

timeDropdown.description: The time dropdown which allows you to pick a time

calendarDropdown.description: The calendar dropdown which allows you to pick a day, year and month

yearDropdown.description: The dropdown that allows you to pick a year

monthDropdown.description: The dropdown that allows you to pick a month

dateDropdown.description: The dropdown that allows you to select a date
